notes.title: Paused Development Due to War
notes.notes: [p]I'm very sorry to announce that active development and support on the Community tab will be suspended until further notice.[/p][p]As a solo developer from Israel, many of you likely understand the challenges of the situation in my country and why I need to focus on my family's well-being.[/p][p]I don’t know when this will end, nor do I have any control over it.[/p][p]I realize how surreal this may sound, especially to someone on the outside. Just a week ago, I was working on patches and updates. Now, I’m waking up to the sound of sirens at night, anxiously listening to rockets overhead and explosions, praying to any god (despite not being religious) that my building won’t be hit.[/p][p]I hope that once this is all over, I’ll be able to return to your requests and continue improving the game.[/p][p]On that note, I want to sincerely thank everyone who bought the game, shared feedback, reported bugs, or left a review. I can’t express how much joy it brings me to hear someone say they enjoy playing the game.[/p][p]Releasing my first game on Steam has been a truly special journey, and I’m deeply grateful to all of you for being a part of it.[/p]

notes.title: Saving Bugs Fixed
notes.notes: [p]I've received many reports about deleted save files and other save-related issues. This patch is intended to resolve all known saving bugs.[/p][p]I'm truly sorry for any lost progress. After extensive testing, we identified a bug that could prevent the game from saving properly when exiting directly from the gameplay scene. This issue should now be fixed, and saving should work as expected moving forward.[/p]

notes.title: Toggled Cleaning
notes.notes:
While the new content update is in progress, toggled cleaning has now been added to the game settings menu :)

To toggle the cleaning control instead of holding the cleaning button:

1. Enable the toggle cleaning in the game settings under controls.
2. Press the cleaning button (LMB) to enable the cleaning toggle.
3. Press the cleaning button (LMB) again to disable the cleaning toggle.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
After many requests, finally, [b]Steam achievements[/b] are now available in Clean It Up!

From selling high to finishing the game as fast as you can, there are now a total of 14 new achievements for players to get, with a secret achievement for players who try to cheat the system ;)

In addition to the Steam achievements integration, small bugs and problems discovered by the community are now fixed!
